# Version history

## v1.0.0

### Additions

- Added chords for custom music tracks to go along with Launch Stars, Coins, etc.

### Changes

- Sprangler Cocoons now have collision and reflect shot Star Bits.
- Removed the death barrier between the airship and boss sections of Kraken King Galaxy.
- When collecting a Green Star, the player will be booted out only if there are any uncollected Green Stars left that can be reached without resetting or falling into death.
- Several dialogues and texts have been updated and cleaned up.
- Some locations now make use of better fitting lighting.
- Various internal adjustments were made to make things cleaner from a developer standpoint.

### Bugfixes

- Ice Bats can now be defeated by Co-Star Luma's Spin Attack.
- The Stamp in Battle Blast Galaxy no longer appears during the Comet mission.
- In the German localization, the Bigmouth Galaxy Luma now has German text.
- The pop-in of objects in various galaxies have been fixed.
